messages.subject: [Synbreed-news] new version of synbreed package
messages.body_plain:
Dear synbreed R-Package users,

a new version 0.2-1 of synbreed pacakge is available on R-Forge. Main new features of the new version are

- vignette for the explanation of the use of the package. Do read, type

 library(synbreed)
 vignette("synbreed")

- function kinship for the construction of gametic relationship matrix.


Best regards,
Valentin
